newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania sees 1996 lead production at 20,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania sees 1996 lead production at 20,000 tonnes.

text.p: Romania expects to produce 20,000 tonnes of lead in 1996, some 2,500 tonnes less than last year, the industry ministry said on Tuesday.
Initial ministry estimates put this year's lead output at 22,500 tonnes.
Lead production over January-September amounted to 13,500 tonnes, 11.1 percent down on the same period last year, ministry data showed. --Adrian Dascalu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
